description: This PHP class, TaskResultProcessor, processes task result files by parsing uploaded files, extracting assets and vulnerabilities, creating related targets and notifications, and storing relevant data into repositories. It integrates with various services and repositories to handle processing, logging, notifications, and database interactions.

classes.name: TaskResultProcessor
classes.description: A class responsible for processing task result files, parsing assets and vulnerabilities, creating targets, sending notifications, and storing findings into repositories.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TaskResultProcessor with dependencies such as logger, redis, repositories, factory, and services.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method that processes an input object representing task result data, handles parsing, target creation, vulnerability storage, and notifications.

methods.name: findOrCreateHost
methods.description: Helper method to find or insert a target host in the target repository, returning the target's ID.
